Part 1 - Classes and Methods / ODWindow

ShouldSave

The ShouldSave method returns a Boolean value that indicates whether this window object should be saved in its draft. 
ODBoolean ShouldSave ();
return value
kODTrue if this window object should be saved in its draft, otherwise kODFalse.
SEE ALSO
The ODWindow::SetShouldSave method (page 835).
